scientific_question: In the supplied final-timestep electrolyzer electrical field at 300 ml/h and 45 mA without surfactant, consider the complete supplied three-dimensional mesh. Investigate the location and intensity of high current-density-magnitude regions. Use all cells, with stored cell values directly and arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Compute the stated properties of the selected object. Weight cell statistics by cell volume and normalize by the included volume. Select cells at or above the volume-weighted 90th percentile of the stated field; use the left inverse of the cumulative volume distribution and retain all ties. Select and explain findings that characterize this scientific target.
